delivery: Existing owner-reviewed PR only; final commit identity is recorded downstream without self-reference. No owner-main push or PR merge.

contract.signature: Native primary omitted; selection, selection_2, platform, engine, syntax and skip_digestion mirrored and forwarded explicitly. No update_view or scientific root alias.
contract.reader: Existing serialized reader binds current primary, including completed pending edits, without adoption, scene projection or history change. Cached methods rebind on replacement and reject empty/closed owners.
contract.science: Complete native parameterized system, selected internal nonbonded contribution or disjoint cross contribution; two-sided partition matrices keep native axes and energy quantities. No selected-subsystem preparation or new model is introduced in the facade.
contract.limits: Mixed partition/flat #561 native TypeError retained. Scientific receiving is bounded to the recorded single-structure CPU NoCutoff AMBER14 model; periodic long-range partitions, overlapping selections, arbitrary force fields and other platforms are not qualified.

scientific_reference.model: Separate OpenMM ForceField amber14-all.xml + amber14/tip3p.xml; NoCutoff, HBonds. Native mechanical calculations/private masking helpers are not used by the numerical oracle.
scientific_reference.formula: All selected Coulomb and Lennard-Jones pairs with arithmetic sigma/geometric epsilon mixing; excluded and scaled 1-4 exceptions taken from the separate force-field model. SciPy CODATA constants supply the Coulomb factor in kJ nm/(mol e**2).

parameters.selection: all in groups of group_index in [0,1]
parameters.selection_2: all in groups of group_index in [4,5]

scientific_reference.unit_policy: kJ/mol and kcal/mol with angstrom display-length policy; results compared explicitly in kJ/mol, output units and unchanged application policy asserted.
scientific_reference.cpu_threads: Test/probe process requests OPENMM_CPU_THREADS=1; no universal native thread-limit guarantee is inferred.

environment.scope: Existing source environment; no clean solve or installed/public qualification.

provider_snapshot.scope: Read-only public source overlay; live provider work and existing installation unchanged. Distribution metadata is not asserted to identify this source.

132 mechanical reader/minimizer/inventory/command cases, including all 38 new nonbonded cases.

initial_receiving.scope: Initial 26 nonbonded cases pass; expanded coverage later adds empty, tuple/NumPy selections and output-policy assertions.

static_checks.ruff: Whole-tree check and format pass; 4381 files already formatted. Initial E731 in an authored test helper was corrected to def before final receiving.
static_checks.course_preservation: Module 20 has 16 original cells; only Markdown cell 12 gains addon prose. Every original code cell, output, ID and metadata entry is preserved.

forces_disposition.authorization: Maintainer explicitly approved opening the native route request after an open/closed issue search found no equivalent.
